notes.title: New update: lock picking system added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080975/130ad496a59b73293b059db5d554df81fb40adb8.png[/img]

Changes: 
- system for opening simple locks has been added (now available in the demo),
- added automatic save system in the first slot,
- ragdoll of enemies has been improved,
- improved shooting - enemy collision detection is now more precise, 
- headshot damage increased.

After updating the demo version, old game saves will not be compatible, it is best to start the game from the beginning.


Regards
Paul

notes.title: Demo fixes
notes.content:
Hello, I have improved a few things in the game:
- you can now enter the Bizarre club
- I added a new type of enemy - a crab (a small group can be found on the beach on the way to the lighthouse)
- now when using food, water... the appropriate function is displayed in the menu (eat, drink, etc.)
-Fixed some lighting bugs
- no sound on linux: if there is no sound or it is very quiet, change the output to Aanalog output (Unity bug sometimes redirects sound to HDMI by default).

Old game saves may not necessarily work properly. It's best to start the demo over again after a version update.

I would be grateful for information about other problems and bugs.

Regards 
Paul

notes.title: Main character sanity system introduced.
notes.content:
The player must make sure that Seth does not become catatonic. There are several ways to take care of your mental hygiene. The level of mental balance can be regained in various ways, including herbs, medicines or stimulants. Some of them cause undesirable effects, such as temporary disturbances in perception or loss of endurance or health.
